name: web_fetch
description: Processes content from URL(s), including local and private network addresses (e.g., localhost), embedded in a prompt. Include up to 20 URLs and instructions (e.g., summarize, extract specific data) directly in the 'prompt' parameter.

prompt.description: A comprehensive prompt that includes the URL(s) (up to 20) to fetch and specific instructions on how to process their content (e.g., "Summarize https://example.com/article and extract key points from https://another.com/data"). All URLs to be fetched must be valid and complete, starting with "http://" or "https://", and be fully-formed with a valid hostname (e.g., a domain name like "example.com" or an IP address). For example, "https://example.com" is valid, but "example.com" is not.
